hooks.text: 武器与头盔各带独特属性和专属招式
hooks.excerpt: Find powerful weapons and helmets, each with a unique attribute and special move! Be it a devastating strike or casting powerful lightning bolts like Zeus!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 阿芙洛狄忒把前代失败转化为属性与新能力
hooks.excerpt: Although burned by the repeated failures of previous heroes, Aphrodite will help you slay the Minotaur by upgrading your agility and strength, or even granting you new abilities! With her help you can become an unstoppable Minotaur slayer!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 击杀牛头人后继续以评级与纪录时间追求效率
hooks.excerpt: Slaying the Minotaur is a battle in itself, but how quickly and efficiently you defeat the Minotaur is the real challenge for those who seek it. Earn ranks for each time you successfully slay the Minotaur and complete challenges to unlock cosmetics! Race against the clock and slay the Minotaur in record time!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
